messages:
Hana (People Ops): Heads-up: candidate Pri (SWE) is in Taipei and asked for a late-morning start 11:30 TPE due to caregiving. Panelers are in PT/CEST. Can we accommodate?
Luis (Recruiter): We can shift. Taro, can panelers start 20:30 PT / 05:30 CEST same day to match 11:30 TPE?
Taro (Hiring Manager): I can do that. Two ICs need to swap hours; trying to get one to cover 21:00 PT. If not, we compress to 3x30m blocks.
Mae (Candidate Coordinator): Candidate requested a supervised browser session for the coding task (proctored) and also asked for a quiet room note on the calendar. Also needs a loaner Chromebook for the proctor tooling.
Hana (People Ops): Chromebook loaner OK? Also check travel stipend rules if she later requests to come onsite. Policy: local Taipei pickups eligible for taxi up to $60 USD with receipts.
ITAssetBot: Reserved 1x Chromebook (APAC-CH-004) from APAC pool. Hold at Taipei hub. Loaner pickup contact: +886 912 345 678. Return label included.
Luis (Recruiter): I'll confirm proctor vendor. Quick policy Q from candidate: does Redwood pay for childcare during interviews? Short answer: no blanket coverage, but we can offer flexible scheduling and a longer break.
Hana (People Ops): We can offer a 75m break window for caregiving. Let's plan flow: 11:30-12:00 coding (proctored), 12:00-13:15 caregiving break, 13:15-13:55 system design, 13:55-14:05 panel debrief.
Taro (Hiring Manager): Works for me. Please ensure proctor session starts on time and NDA signed before access to private repo.
Mae (Candidate Coordinator): Sent DocuSign NDA at 09:45 TPE; candidate signed at 10:10. Proctor vendor (WatchfulProctor) confirmed slot.
TravelBot: Loaner APAC-CH-004: ready for pickup at Taipei hub. Tracking pickup code: TPE-LO-778.
Luis (Recruiter): Candidate phone confirmed +886 912 345 678. Also requested a vegetarian lunch voucher during break. Can Facilities handle voucher or e-gift?
Hana (People Ops): Facilities to do an e-gift voucher. Add "quiet room" and "long break (75m)" to calendar invite. Also set repo expiry to 6 hours after access.
Mae (Candidate Coordinator): Internal calendar invite draft below — copy into event when creating. Please review:
```
Title: Redwood Final Loop - Pri (SWE)
When: Thu 11:30-14:05 TPE (20:30-23:05 PT)
Where: Zoom + Taipei hub loaner pickup (APAC-CH-004)
Agenda: 11:30-12:00 Proctored coding (chromebook), 12:00-13:15 Caregiving break, 13:15-13:55 System design, 13:55-14:05 Panel debrief (internal)
Notes: NDA signed. Proctor vendor WatchfulProctor confirmed. Quiet room requested. Vegetarian lunch e-gift during break. Repo link expires 6h after access.
Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.example/pri-final
```
Taro (Hiring Manager): Please also set a short text for panel: "Be punctual; proctor will lock screen at start. Mark any accessibility observations on the scorecard"
Hana (People Ops): Final: reminder to panel to complete Greenhouse scorecards within 24h and to route any expense receipts to expenses@redwood.example. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
